verdict.rationale: Helicone documents rule-based event triggers in two places. Webhooks fire automatically when LLM requests complete, gated by property filters, so only requests matching all specified properties trigger them; the docs pitch this for automating workflows and real-time scoring. Alerts let you configure filters on error rates and costs and automatically notify through Slack or email. Missing for 10: a general rule engine beyond request-completion events and error/cost thresholds, actions other than webhook or notification delivery, richer rule logic than property matching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
